description.value: Ten years of firing two guns at once and the off hand has stopped being the second one. Your hands no longer take turns — they simply both work, and the penalty for splitting your attention between them is gone for good. A Gun Failure on one weapon has never once made you stop, and now it does not even slow you down: the other hand covers the gap in the same motion that clears the jam.
